errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the x-axis label "random +B1". The chart shows labels such as "random +B2" and "random layers +B2", but not "random +B1".

The list of horizontal axis labels is incomplete and inaccurate. It omits several labels shown in the chart, such as "embedding", "random layers", and several variations with "+R2". It also incorrectly lists "layers" as a standalone category.
The blue bars for "embedding" and "1st layer" have accuracy values between approximately 80 and 82. The reported range of 72 to 76 is incorrect.
The green bars correspond to categories starting with "random layers", not just "random". The "random" category and its variations are associated with red bars.
The green bars have values in the approximate range of 79.5 to 82. The stated range of 73 to 83 is inaccurate, particularly the lower bound.
This is an incomplete list of the models represented by red bars. It omits "random", "random +R2", and "random +permute".
The red bars have values between approximately 71.5 and 73.5. The reported range of 66 to 72 is incorrect.

errors.evidence: The orange bars have values of approximately 90.5 and 91.5. The range 88 to 92 is too broad and its lower bound is inaccurate.

The description fails to mention the grouped nature of the bars. For most categories, there is a pair of bars (one light, one dark), which is a key structural component of the chart used for comparison.
